name: [UPD 4🍥] Guess The Real Size!
desc:
📏 HOW BIG IS IT REALLY? GUESS THE SIZE, WIN THE DUEL!

👍 LIKE, ⭐ FAVORITE & 👥 JOIN THE GROUP for 200 FREE COINS + an exclusive RGB chair!

A giraffe next to a bus. A ladybug next to Mount Everest... how big is it?

- ⚔️ Sit at a table for a 1v1 duel: stretch the object to the size you think is right.
- 🎯 Closest guess blasts the other player. 4 lives, last one standing wins!
- 🌍 ALOT OF real objects: animals, dinosaurs, monuments, vehicles, planets, galaxies...
- 🤖 No opponent? Solo Play against the training bot.
- 💀 HARD MODE: 10 wins to enter, 6 seconds, any size, double coins.
- 🧠 Sharp guesses raise your IQ. Climb the leaderboards!
- 💰 Win coins, open crates, unlock guns and chairs... can you afford the Shadow Monarch?
- 👀 Watch other duels live on their table.

Sizes are approximate. Real names are used for size comparison only; this game is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.

llm.loop: sit at a table for a 1v1 -> stretch an object to the size you think is real -> the closer guess blasts the other player -> last one standing wins coins, crates and IQ
llm.instructions: stretch objects to guess real size; 4 lives; solo vs bot; hard mode after 10 wins
unique: real-world size estimation as a duel
